overall_notes: The paper focuses on teaching LLMs to generate confidence estimates and self-reflective rationales for question answering tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of redundant descriptions and normalization of naming conventions. The paper uses both automatic metrics (ECE, AUROC, Accuracy) and human/LLM evaluation focused on faithfulness of the generated rationales.
